# Findings — 4 estate surfaces vs. the build-out (Lens Stack · light-maze-3D · eigen-map overlay · mix law)

Framework: `watch/inbox/ELDER_DASH25_RULING_20260922.md` — "harvest the mechanism, tombstone the shell"; verdict = graft / tombstone / idle with a bar.

---

## 1. `dashboard/static/museum/estate_walk.lod.html`
*(not at repo root — the real path is under `museum/`; built by `dashboard/static/_build_estate_walk.py`, `OUT_LOD`, lines 31, 35)*

**Does:** Zone-LOD index over the estate graph. Overview = 4×4 grid of zone summaries only (node/edge/star counts, type histograms, 6 sample titles). The full ~667KB payload sits embedded in `<script type="application/json" id="full">` and is `JSON.parse`d **only** on zone-open or "expand: full estate" — `ensureFull()` at lines 43–49, `openZone` 66–70, `inView` culling 77–81. Click-to-open, pan/zoom, Escape→overview. Own note (line 28): *"the index starts from summaries only; the full estate payload sits inert below until a zone is opened."*

**Steering mechanism:** Summary-first progressive disclosure — never pay for detail until the view demands it.

**Serves the new tools?** Weakly. It's the context-budget shape (JEV = "which context each request gets"; cf. `watch/inbox/LIGHT_MAZE_3D_WALK_20260922.md`: "radius = context budget"), and a coarse gauge the eigen-map could subdivide. But the mechanism is one 7-line lazy-parse, the data is frozen at 09-16, and it has **zero consumers** (`watch/inbox/THE_WEAVE_20260916.md` V-5: "estate_walk.lod + GET /mud/state spectator door (zero consumers)").

**Verdict: idle** (bar: high). Already curated into `museum/`; pattern too thin to graft, shell too parked to bother tombstoning. Leave it.

---

## 2. `dashboard/static/estate_walk.html`

**Does:** 599KB self-contained replay of the repo as a two-floor space. Mycelium floor = nodes + edge corridors (from `memory/mycelium/graph_snapshot.json` + `edges.jsonl`); estate floor = git star field + commit pulses. Lane "lanterns" walk **BFS real corridors** between trail waypoints (`bfsPath`, lines 58–67) driven by a replay clock — seek slider (139–146), speed 0.5–8×, play/pause, floor toggle (both/mycelium/estate), per-lane legend toggles. Honest receipt at line 37: trail rows carry no graph ids → lantern waypoints are a *deterministic projection*, but "every walk follows real corridors. commits & artifact pulses are placed exactly."

**Steering mechanism:** Deterministic time-projection onto the real graph — you steer the estate by scrubbing time; motion is constrained to least-path corridors.

**Serves the new tools?** Yes, twice:
- **eigen-map overlay** — this *is* the walker view the rung wants (`queue/todo.md:160-165`: "overlay position/distance/bearing on the walker view. Data already exists"). Camera + node coords + BFS paths = the substrate; eigen centroids become the layer on top.
- **light-maze-3D** — `bfsPath` over real edges is the same least-time corridor grammar `shadow_walk.solveField()` calls "Fermat paths."
- Mix law: the lane replay is a mass-over-time chart of the fleet's lanes.

**Verdict: graft-mechanism** (bar: high). Carry the corridor-walk + time-scrub as the eigen-map underlay; the 599KB baked payload itself (`_build_estate_walk.py` output, data 09-14-stale per `watch/inbox/static_rebuild/G2_STATIC_INFRA_AUDIT.md:113`) can rebuild or rest.

## Light family — d02-light findings

Files read: `dashboard/static/salon_lightmap.html` (399 lines), `dashboard/static/room_lightmap.html` (96), `dashboard/static/light_maze.html` (230), `dashboard/static/wipeout_lightmaze.html` (240). Context: `watch/inbox/wave_spec_dashboard25.json`, `watch/inbox/ELDER_DASH25_RULING_20260922.md`.

### 1. salon_lightmap.html — the aim budget
- **DOES:** Live 2D radial-shadow instrument. One movable light, N=256 rays; three passes — bake occluder mask (alpha>0.75), build d(θ) first-hit horizon (salon_lightmap.html:215-227), render `lit = step(r, d(θ))` with 9-tap angular penumbra × radial falloff × gaze (salon_lightmap.html:245-266). v2 fetches `room_state.json`: occluders are fleet organs, brightness tracks 200-step attention hits, fire-rate economy JOINED/ghost/PRUNE, invariant walls in gold, "NO HASH → NO DRAW" (salon_lightmap.html:364-396).
- **Mechanism:** The **GAZE LAW** — a 110° louver around AIM; inside = full, outside = hard 15% floor (salon_lightmap.html:121-124, 230-236). Attention is a *budget*, not a flood. Plus the strip's three-way UNSEEN taxonomy (slate=outside-aim, amber=occluded, teal=seen, salon_lightmap.html:278-288), and occlusion ≠ visibility: PRUNE walls keep geometry and keep casting shadow (darkness ≠ absence, line 49).
- **Carries into light-maze-3D:** gaze louver → camera/beam aim cone with a non-zero darkness floor; d(θ) → the compressed occlusion cache (256 numbers is the whole shadow state) as the 3D horizon-buffer pattern; the UNSEEN taxonomy as the render's epistemic coloring; hash-gated drawing as provenance discipline.
- **Verdict: GRAFT** — graft the gaze louver + d(θ) horizon + unseen-taxonomy; the page itself stays as the live room instrument.

### 2. room_lightmap.html — multi-light field, no aim
- **DOES:** Static plate dated 2026-09-02. Hardcoded SDF scene (covenant rect, four failure-class pillars, THE FOLD ring, "the screen"), five wandering engine-lights (A1/B1/D1/forge/harvest, room_lightmap.html:42-48), per-light sphere-traced 1D distance field (360 rays, room_lightmap.html:52-66), per-pixel additive composite with soft field-edge shade and 1/(d²) attenuation (lines 82-87). No interaction, no data fetch, lights orbit on parametric loops.
- **Mechanism:** Attention is *autonomous* — you don't aim; the engines wander and you watch what their fields overlap. Occlusion = SDF sphere tracing; **occluder surfaces glow their own color at contact** (room_lightmap.html:87) — touching a wall partially illuminates it. Soft penumbra = `(dist − f[θ]) / 0.15` threshold band (line 82).
- **Carries into light-maze-3D:** the field-edge shade formula (penumbra as horizon-tolerance, no shadow-map filtering needed); inverse-square multi-light compositing; occluder-contact glow as hit feedback (the maze paints what the beam touches); SDF sphere tracing as the cheap 3D occluder.
- **Verdict: TOMBSTONE** — dated, inert, hardcoded shell; harvest the field-edge shade + contact-glow, hash, rest.

### 3. light_maze.html — sight becomes knowledge
- **DOES:** Actual game. WASD player *is* the light; segment-wall maze; visibility polygon by casting to every wall endpoint ±0.0001 rad (light_maze.html:91-103); a glyph lights only if inside the polygon **and** line-of-sight clear (lines 144-151), and **stays lit permanently** — sighting converts to memory. H fires the Sherpa hand toward the nearest unlit glyph (lines 60-70). Door opens only when all 7 glyphs are lit; timer verdict (lines 152-159, 206-211).
- **Mechanism:** "What you see is what you know" — occlusion as epistemics, not shading. Exact geometric occlusion (seg-seg, lines 167-173). Transient sight → durable knowledge (litOnce ledger). The Sherpa hand = *delegated aim*: a wall that points (the help mechanism, HUD line 18).
